# Lodgingeo

> Lodgingeo is the hotel-data service of Location Drive: a global database of 5.8 million places to stay, including 2.6 million hotels, in 250 countries and territories. Each record has coordinates and address, publicly listed contact details, nightly rates across booking sites, a building polygon, neighbourhood context and monthly change history since January 2025. Data is delivered as CSV, Excel or a shared Google Sheet, per country or worldwide, updated monthly. Quotes are by email; no prices are published.
